author: Leena Nasir
title: Bobby Brown Slams Britney Spears, Says She 'Butchered' His Song | The Daily Caller
text:
American singer-songwriter and rapper Bobby Brown torched Britney Spears for her rendition of his 1988 hit song, “Prerogative,” on Shannon Sharpe’s “Club Shay Shay” podcast Thursday.
The famous singer didn’t mince words when asked how he felt about other artists sampling his music, making it clear he has to hear the songs first.
“I gotta hear it,” Brown said. “You don’t know what these kids will say these days!” he exclaimed. Brown continued, saying, “You don’t want your song associated with them. So, yeah, you gotta listen to it.” He also said he felt Spears’s version of his song “was a butchering.”
Sharpe began by asking Brown if he liked any of the samples by other artists who redid his music.
“Um, I don’t think they did it justice,” Brown replied. “I don’t think they really did justice to any of the samples they have done to my songs.”
Brown then laced into Spears, making it clear that he thought her version did not meet his standards.
“Like Britney Spears: butchered, she butchered ‘Prerogative,'” he said.
“Teddy Riley produced it but that was a butchering that you know,” he continued. “I couldn’t take it!”
Sharpe reminded the famous singer he had authorized Spears to take on the task of sampling his tune . (RELATED: Dolly Parton Makes Rare Misstep, Partners With Heretical Pop Star Sabrina Carpenter For New Song)
“I cleared it only because it was Britney Spears and I was thinking, ‘Teddy Riley’s doing it too,’ you know, but I feel it was a butchering,” Brown said.
Spears has yet to comment on the negative feedback about her rendition of the song.
